scene:
As the hours passed, nothing terrible happened. The farmhouse still swayed in the air, and the wind still roared outside, but I grew less frightened little by little.

I kept Toto close beside me. Aunt Em remained in the little cellar below, and I knew that she was safe there. The house had not fallen, and no new danger came. So I stayed inside the room with Toto while the strange journey continued.
